title: Reign of David over Israel
description: Added from the Generations curriculum import (Preparing the World for Jesus (1st ed., 2020)). Jones, Appendix F (23rd ed., 2026), sets the sort. The Generations dates below stay on display.

sorting_basis.note: Tier 3: Ussher-Jones (Floyd Nolen Jones): 1055 BC (no higher-tier year available).

chronologies.note: pending CFAH reference (the CFAH series does not cover this period; no tier 1–4 date exists)

chronologies.citation: Jones, The Chronology of the Old Testament: A Return to the Basics, 23rd ed. (Master Books, 2026), Appendix F, printed p. 279 (PDF p. 314)
chronologies.note: This record begins when David takes the throne (the Generations span starts in 1055). Jones's line is the accession over Judah. "David made king over all the tribes" is a separate Appendix F line (2956 AM, 1048 BC) and is not used here.

chronologies.citation: Preparing the World for Jesus (1st ed., 2020), ch. 6 "The Special People of God", PDF p. 199 (printed p. 198)
chronologies.note: The Lord shifts the dynasty to David; the kings table (p. 208) gives 1055-1015 BC; Timeline Review (p. 212): "David Takes Throne 1055 bc".
chronologies.edition_note: 1st ed. (2020); superseded by the 2nd ed. (2024), which prints "1055–1015" (PDF p. 370): the same date.

chronologies.citation: Preparing the World for Jesus (2nd ed., 2024), ch. 15 "The Rise and Fall of Israel's Monarchy", PDF p. 370 (printed p. 356)
